Last month, SpaceXAI launched Grok Bot, an iMessage-style AI system that presents agents as team members. The product was initially launched as iPhone and Mac apps with a very high price tag. Within a few weeks of launch, Grok Bot has expanded to iPad and significantly reduced its pricing.

Grok Bot Arrives on iPad and Android

Like many AI services, Grok Bot originally launched on Mac, alongside an iPhone app. This week, SpaceXAI is expanding Grok Bot to two additional platforms: Android and iPad.

The tablet release comes as Grok Bot gains enterprise support. For enterprise customers of Grok and Cursor, Grok Bot will be free for the next few weeks.

Meanwhile, the cost of trying Grok Bot (outside the free trial) has dropped significantly in recent weeks.

The AI agent system originally required a $300 per month subscription. Now Grok Bot is available with Cursor Pro for $20 per month, comparable to other entry-level AI subscriptions.

SpaceXAI recently acquired Cursor, a deal that has helped it become more competitive in the AI space despite being behind.
